subject.title: Feature Request: Add MathJax/LaTeX Support to Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor first-party Control UI math rendering in core, and if so which default-off renderer/config/sanitizer approach should be accepted?
rationale: The feature has clear user demand and fits web frontend ergonomics, but it adds a core UI dependency or bundled asset path, a possible public config surface, and sanitizer behavior for untrusted chat content.

options.title: Sponsor one core implementation
options.body: Review one current KaTeX, MathJax, or MathML implementation to completion with dependency/security approval and real Control UI proof, then close this issue after merge.

options.title: Defer out of core
options.body: Keep core markdown unchanged unless a plugin/API gap blocks a safer external implementation.

options.title: Close as not planned
options.body: Decline first-party math rendering for now and close the related candidate PRs and duplicates with a clear product rationale.

recommendation.title: Sponsor one core implementation
recommendation.body: Review one current KaTeX, MathJax, or MathML implementation to completion with dependency/security approval and real Control UI proof, then close this issue after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This is mainly a product/security/config decision, and steipete is tied to the original chat markdown path plus adjacent UI dependency/config history.
